# ── THE FILTER, 190 bits: 4-address QoS+HTC frame. The base Blur (addr1‖addr2‖addr3[0:4]) is byte-
# identical to the base rows above; addr4 ‖ QoS Control carry the additive 64-bit extra projection
# (key XOR "ndn/tier0-xtra!"); HT Control carries the 24-bit name fingerprint (low bits of the keyed
# name hash, little-endian) ‖ the REGION BITMAP (bit0 addr4, bit1 QoS) = 0x03. extra_fill_cap demotes a
# frame to the base region above it. Reproduced by the firmware (Rust) and ath9k-htc (C) ports.
